description: Fixed retrieval evaluation set. Grounded cases must be answered with a citation from the expected title+page; unsupported cases must be honestly abstained. The upload document is built by scripts/eval-retrieval.mjs (three pages, one fact per page).

cases.question: Where do the light-dependent reactions of photosynthesis take place?
Which organelle converts light energy into glucose?
What does cellular respiration consume to produce ATP?
Which molecules are produced by the light-dependent reactions?
What process consumes oxygen and produces ATP?
What is the capital of France?
